channel.title: Amazon Bedrock · News (English)
channel.description: Amazon Bedrock official blog / changelog in English (最近 50 条, 50 items). Generated by free-llm-intel.

item.title: Updated topic: Watermarking in Amazon Bedrock
item.content:encoded: Added Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Mythos 5 to the models that add a watermark.

item.title: Distribute already-accepted private offers from AWS Marketpl…
item.description: Full title: Distribute already-accepted private offers from AWS Marketplace
item.content:encoded:
You can now distribute a private offer for a third-party model in Amazon Bedrock from the agreement in AWS Marketplace. A new

Distribution status

column on the

Manage subscriptions

page shows which agreements you haven't distributed. For more information, see

Distribute through AWS Marketplace

.

item.title: Added Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
item.content:encoded:
Added model cards for

Claude Fable 5.2

and

Claude Mythos 5.2

. Both models are available on the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint through US, AWS GovCloud (US), and Global cross-Region inference. Updated the Adaptive thinking, Extended thinking, Preserved thinking, Tool use, Computer use, Prompt caching, Fallback credit, Watermarking, Data retention, Abuse detection, and Quotas pages, and added a 2.5x output token burndown rate for Claude Mythos 5, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Mythos 5.2. Updated the

Claude Mythos 5.1

model card to add computer use, client toolsets, compaction, and the

aws_review

data retention mode. Corrected compaction support: added Compaction to the Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 model cards, listed both compaction beta values on supported model cards, expanded the

compact-2026-01-12

supported-model list, and marked compaction as not supported on Claude Haiku 4.5. Added Claude Sonnet 5.5 to the models that support mid-conversation tool changes.

item.title: Added Kimi K3.1 Pro - Highspeed
item.content:encoded:
Added the

Kimi K3.1 Pro - Highspeed model card

and updated the Moonshot AI catalog and availability references (API compatibility, endpoint availability, and model Region availability). Kimi K3.1 Pro - Highspeed is available on the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint through US and India geographic cross-Region inference and Global cross-Region inference.

item.title: New topic: Watermarking in Amazon Bedrock
item.content:encoded:
Added a topic that lists the models in Amazon Bedrock that add a watermark to their output and describes how to detect the watermark. For more information, see

Watermarking in Amazon Bedrock

.

item.title: Clarified when Advanced Prompt Optimization prompt shortenin…
item.description: Full title: Clarified when Advanced Prompt Optimization prompt shortening returns the original prompt
item.content:encoded:
Clarified that prompt shortening depends on your evaluation. If the original prompt already scores at the maximum on your evaluation samples, or if the samples do not distinguish between candidate prompts, the original prompt is returned with a compression ratio of 1.0. Added guidance on choosing evaluation samples that give the optimizer room to improve. Updated the

Shorten prompts

page and the

Troubleshooting

page.

item.title: Clarified batch inference completion behavior and quotas
item.content:encoded:
Clarified on the Capacity and Performance page that on-demand requests are prioritized over batch inference jobs and that job completion is not guaranteed. Added the default and maximum job timeout (24 hours by default, up to 168 hours). Replaced the fixed job size and file size values with a link to the batch inference quotas in the AWS General Reference. Updated the

Capacity and Performance

page and the

Create a batch inference job

page.

item.title: Distribute private offers from AWS Marketplace
item.content:encoded:
You can now distribute private offers for third-party models in Amazon Bedrock to your organization on the AWS Marketplace purchase confirmation page, right after you accept the offer. For all other subscriptions, continue to distribute through AWS License Manager. For more information, see

Distribute through AWS Marketplace

.

item.title: Advanced Prompt Optimization supports prompt shortening and…
item.description: Full title: Advanced Prompt Optimization supports prompt shortening and application inference profiles
item.content:encoded:
You can enable prompt shortening per prompt template to reduce prompt length while maintaining or improving evaluation scores. Application inference profiles are accepted as target models and judge models. Results include median time to first token and average and median latency. For more information, see

Shorten prompts

.

item.title: Retrieval instructions for Amazon Bedrock agentic retrieval
item.content:encoded:
Agentic retrieval on fully managed Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases now supports retrieval instructions. A retrieval instruction steers how the agent searches your knowledge bases and how it answers. Amazon Bedrock reviews each instruction before it takes effect, and you can pin an immutable version. Use the

retrievalInstructionConfiguration

field on

AgenticRetrieveStream

to apply one. For more information, see

Create and manage retrieval instructions

.

item.title: Contextual grounding checks support safeguard tiers
item.content:encoded:
Amazon Bedrock Guardrails contextual grounding checks now support Standard tier. Standard tier supports responses that include reasoning or conversational content, returns more consistent scores, and supports additional languages. For more information, see

Use contextual grounding check to filter hallucinations in responses

and

Safeguard tiers for guardrails policies

.

item.title: Structured outputs now available for Anthropic Claude models…
item.description: Full title: Structured outputs now available for Anthropic Claude models on both endpoints
item.content:encoded:
Structured outputs is now available for Anthropic Claude models on both the

bedrock-runtime

and

bedrock-mantle

endpoints. Added a Claude-focused

Structured outputs for Anthropic Claude models

page, updated the

Structured outputs

page, and updated the affected Claude model cards.

item.title: Added India geographic cross-Region inference for Kimi K3
item.content:encoded:
Kimi K3 is now available through India geographic cross-Region inference (the

in.moonshotai.kimi-k3

inference profile) in the Asia Pacific (Mumbai) (

ap-south-1

) and Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) (

ap-south-2

) Regions. Updated the

Kimi K3 model card

and the model Region availability reference.

item.title: Added GPT-6.1 Sol
item.content:encoded:
Added the

GPT-6.1 Sol model card

and updated the OpenAI catalog and availability references. GPT-6.1 Sol is available on the Mantle endpoint in US East (N. Virginia) and through US geographic cross-Region inference on bedrock-runtime. The model card includes OpenAI first-party base pricing, the 10% regional and US CRIS premium, and lifecycle terms aligned with OpenAI.

item.title: Updated the tokens-per-day quota on the bedrock-runtime endp…
item.description: Full title: Updated the tokens-per-day quota on the bedrock-runtime endpoint to a cross-model, per-account quota
item.content:encoded:
Replaced the per-model

Model invocation max tokens per day

quota with a

Cross-Model Max Tokens Per Day

quota that is scoped per account, per Region across all supported Amazon Bedrock models. Updated the quota types table and the grouped quota-increase guidance on the

Quotas for the bedrock-runtime endpoint

page accordingly.

item.title: Updated the Tokens per day (TPD) definition to a cross-model…
item.description: Full title: Updated the Tokens per day (TPD) definition to a cross-model, per-account quota
item.content:encoded:
Updated the

Tokens per day (TPD)

term in the token quota terminology table on the

Token-based quota calculation

page to describe a cross-model, per-account daily token quota across all supported Amazon Bedrock models, consistent with the updated

Quotas for the bedrock-runtime endpoint

page.

item.title: Updated OpenAI-compatible API guidance to prefer bedrock-run…
item.description: Full title: Updated OpenAI-compatible API guidance to prefer bedrock-runtime
item.content:encoded:
Made

bedrock-runtime

the recommended path for new Responses API and Chat Completions API integrations. Added neutral canonical pages and redirects from the previous

bedrock-mantle

-named pages, led with Runtime examples, documented that the OpenAI-compatible

/models

operation isn't available on

bedrock-runtime

, and directed customers to

ListFoundationModels

,

ListInferenceProfiles

, and model cards for discovery. Corrected GPT OSS model cards and examples to use the versioned Runtime model IDs for Chat Completions and to show that GPT OSS doesn't support the Responses API on

bedrock-runtime

. Updated the Quickstart to use a system inference profile that supports both OpenAI-compatible APIs on Runtime.

item.title: Added Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
item.content:encoded:
Added model cards for

Claude Fable 5.1

and

Claude Mythos 5.1

. Updated the Adaptive thinking, Extended thinking, Tool use, and Prompt caching pages. Added a new

Thinking block binding (beta)

topic.

item.title: Corrected Claude Sonnet 5 thinking guidance: adaptive thinki…
item.description: Full title: Corrected Claude Sonnet 5 thinking guidance: adaptive thinking is on by default and can be disabled
item.content:encoded:
Corrected the Reasoning entry on the

Claude Sonnet 5

model card, which incorrectly stated that adaptive thinking is always on and cannot be disabled. On Claude Sonnet 5, adaptive thinking is on by default — including for requests that omit the

thinking

field — and can be turned off by passing

"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}

. Added Claude Sonnet 5 to the supported models table on the

Adaptive thinking

topic, and added guidance covering the default-on behavior change from Claude Sonnet 4.6, the fact that only the explicit

disabled

thinking type turns thinking off (omitting the

thinking

field selects adaptive thinking, and

budget_tokens

is not supported on this model), that thinking tokens are billed as output tokens, and the need to revisit

max_tokens

for workloads migrated from Claude Sonnet 4.6.

item.title: Fixed Anthropic Messages API code samples and switched model…
item.description: Full title: Fixed Anthropic Messages API code samples and switched model-card OpenAI-SDK samples to bedrock-runtime
item.content:encoded:
Fixed the Anthropic Messages API Python sample on the

Overview

page, which previously used

anthropic.Anthropic()

with no base URL and failed with a validation exception. Every Anthropic Messages API Python sample now uses the plain

Anthropic

client from the Anthropic SDK, targets the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint's

/anthropic

route directly with

base_url="https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/anthropic"

, and authenticates with a short-term Amazon Bedrock bearer token generated by

aws-bedrock-token-generator

's

provide_token()

. Updated the Sample Code section of every Anthropic model card that supports

bedrock-runtime

(Claude Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5, and Fable 5) to use this pattern with the model's Global inference ID, and updated the corresponding

pip install

line to

pip install -U anthropic aws-bedrock-token-generator

. Updated the same sample on the

Quickstart

page, the

Messages API

topic, and the

Tool use

reference topic. Reordered the code sample tabs on the Messages API topic to lead with

bedrock-runtime

variants (Anthropic SDK, boto3, AWS CLI, curl) and moved the

bedrock-mantle

curl tab to the end. Repointed the

OPENAI_BASE_URL

environment variable on 49 non-Anthropic model cards (OpenAI, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, Google, Meta, Qwen, MiniMax, NVIDIA, Moonshot AI, Z.AI, Writer, xAI) from the

bedrock-mantle

/v1

route to the

bedrock-runtime

/openai/v1

route (

https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1

) so the Responses API and Chat Completions API samples in the Sample Code section run against

bedrock-runtime

by default. The

bedrock-mantle

endpoint continues to be fully supported and pages that document mantle-only features (Web Search, Projects, Workspaces, Chat Completions on mantle, the mantle Responses API page) still show

bedrock-mantle

URLs.

item.title: Updated endpoint guidance to recommend the bedrock-runtime e…
item.description: Full title: Updated endpoint guidance to recommend the bedrock-runtime endpoint
item.content:encoded:
Updated the endpoint and API guidance across the Amazon Bedrock User Guide to recommend the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint for new applications, including for OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible workloads. Changes include reordered quickstart tabs and code samples on the

Overview

and

Quickstart

pages, reordered endpoint and API guidance on the

Endpoints

,

APIs

, and

Build

pages, reordered Programmatic Access sections in model cards, retitled the

Responses API

and

Chat Completions API

pages that document the

bedrock-mantle

variants, and added cross-reference tips on the

Projects

and

Workspaces

pages. The

bedrock-mantle

endpoint continues to be fully supported and existing applications that use it do not need to change.

item.title: Follow-up bedrock-runtime positioning updates in Quickstart…
item.description: Full title: Follow-up bedrock-runtime positioning updates in Quickstart and model cards
item.content:encoded:
Follow-up updates continuing the

bedrock-runtime

positioning work. Reordered the code sample tabs on the

Quickstart

page to lead with the Messages API, followed by the Responses, Chat Completions, Converse, and Invoke APIs. The Messages API tab now targets the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint using the

AnthropicBedrock

client (AWS SigV4 auth), so all Quickstart tabs consistently use

bedrock-runtime

. Updated the Quickstart code samples to use Claude Opus 5 for Anthropic and GPT-5.6 Sol for OpenAI. Added a suggestion callout under the Model Details section of every model card that supports

bedrock-runtime

, recommending the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint for new applications. Added Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber and Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol to the OpenAI row of the

Models at a glance

summary table.

item.title: AgentCore Memory integration for Amazon Bedrock agentic retr…
item.description: Full title: AgentCore Memory integration for Amazon Bedrock agentic retrieval
item.content:encoded:
Agentic retrieval on fully managed Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases now integrates with

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory

. Use the

memoryConfiguration

field on

AgenticRetrieveStream

to configure memory. You can restore an earlier session from short-term memory, let the agent retrieve memory records from long-term memory, or both. For more information, see

Use agentic retrieval to query a knowledge base

.

item.title: IAM principal cost allocation now supported on the bedrock-m…
item.description: Full title: IAM principal cost allocation now supported on the bedrock-mantle endpoint
item.content:encoded:
Amazon Bedrock now supports cost allocation by IAM principal (users and roles) for inference requests made through the

bedrock-mantle

endpoint, extending the capability previously available for

bedrock-runtime

. Tag IAM users and roles with attributes such as team, project, or cost center, activate them as cost allocation tags, and analyze

bedrock-mantle

inference costs by those tags in AWS Cost Explorer or at the line-item level in AWS Cost and Usage Report 2.0 (CUR 2.0). Available in all AWS Regions where the

bedrock-mantle

endpoint is available. For more information, see

IAM principal attribution in Amazon Bedrock

.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic is no longer open to new custo…
item.description: Full title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic is no longer open to new customers.
item.content:encoded:
Amazon Bedrock Agents (now Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic) is no longer open to new customers. For capabilities similar to Bedrock Agents Classic, explore

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

. Existing customers can continue to use the service as normal. For more information, see

Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic availability change

.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic availability change
item.content:encoded:
Amazon Bedrock Agents (launched November 2023) is now Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic and will no longer be open to new customers starting on July 30, 2026. If you would like to use Bedrock Agents Classic, sign up prior to that date. Existing customers can continue to use the service as normal. For more information, see

Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic maintenance mode

.

item.title: Updated requests-per-minute (RPM) quota guidance
item.content:encoded:
Clarified RPM quota behavior across Amazon Bedrock endpoints. The

bedrock-mantle

endpoint does not expose per-model RPM quotas; throttling is governed by token-based quotas. On the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint, RPM quotas are model-specific — some models, including Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Opus 4.8, are not subject to an RPM quota. For models that do have an RPM quota, see the Service Quotas console.

item.title: Quotas for the bedrock-runtime endpoint
item.content:encoded:
Added a dedicated page that describes the per-model token quotas that govern inference traffic to the

bedrock-runtime

endpoint and points to related quotas for custom inference profiles, batch inference, and Provisioned Throughput.

item.title: Quotas for the bedrock-mantle endpoint
item.content:encoded:
Documented the per-model input and output token quotas that govern inference traffic to the

bedrock-mantle

endpoint, including the default values for Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7, the request evaluation order, the differences from

bedrock-runtime

quotas, and how to request quota increases through AWS Support.

item.title: Token counting on the bedrock-mantle endpoint
item.content:encoded:
Documented how to count input tokens through the Anthropic

count_tokens

path on the

bedrock-mantle

endpoint, including for Claude models that are not supported by

CountTokens

on

bedrock-runtime

.

item.title: Fully managed knowledge bases with agentic retrieval
item.content:encoded: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases now offers fully managed knowledge bases, where Amazon Bedrock manages the storage, indexing, and retrieval infrastructure for you. Fully managed knowledge bases also support agentic retrieval with the AgenticRetrieveStream API, which uses a foundation model to decompose complex queries into sub-queries and iteratively retrieve relevant information.

item.title: Converse API support for batch inference
item.content:encoded: You can now use the Converse API format for batch inference input data. When creating a batch inference job, set the model invocation type to Converse to use a consistent request format across models.

item.title: Added support for fine-tuning open-weight models using OpenA…
item.description: Full title: Added support for fine-tuning open-weight models using OpenAI-compatible APIs. You can now create, monitor, and manage reinforcement…
item.content:encoded: Added support for fine-tuning open-weight models using OpenAI-compatible APIs. You can now create, monitor, and manage reinforcement fine-tuning jobs for open-weight models through familiar OpenAI SDK endpoints, including Files API, fine-tuning jobs APIs, and inference APIs.

item.content:encoded: Updated list of models supported for priority and flex service tiers

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Data Automation now supports blueprint instru…
item.description: Full title: Amazon Bedrock Data Automation now supports blueprint instruction optimization for documents. Improve Data Automation custom output accuracy…
item.content:encoded: Amazon Bedrock Data Automation now supports blueprint instruction optimization for documents. Improve Data Automation custom output accuracy by providing example content assets with ground truth labels, enabling you to achieve production-ready accuracy for documents in minutes without model training.

item.title: New managed policies
item.content:encoded: Amazon Bedrock added the following managed IAM policies for Amazon Bedrock Mantle: AmazonBedrockMantleFullAccess, AmazonBedrockMantleReadOnly, AmazonBedrockMantleInferenceAccess. Amazon Bedrock Mantle provides OpenAI-compatible API endpoints for model inference.

item.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports OpenAI compatible API endpoints,…
item.description: Full title: Amazon Bedrock now supports OpenAI compatible API endpoints, including Responses API and Chat Completions API. These endpoints enable…
item.content:encoded: Amazon Bedrock now supports OpenAI compatible API endpoints, including Responses API and Chat Completions API. These endpoints enable asynchronous inference for long-running workloads, stateful conversation management without manual history passing, and simplified tool use integration for agentic workflows. Migrate existing applications with minimal code changes by updating your base URL and API key.

item.title: Enhanced coding use case support for Standard tier
item.content:encoded: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails Standard tier now provides enhanced support for coding use cases. Content filters, prompt attacks, and denied topics have been upgraded to better handle code-related prompts and responses without requiring changes to existing configurations. Added comprehensive code domain support documentation and prompt leakage detection for Standard tier.
